title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
summary: The analyzer regressed after version 3.1.0: starting with 3.1.1, it stops working when SuppressSourceGeneration is set to true.

criteria.text: The analyzer performs its normal analysis when SuppressSourceGeneration=true, restoring the working behavior observed in version 3.1.0.

open_questions: Which analyzer and concrete diagnostics or output should be used to verify that it is working?
What project configuration and reproduction steps demonstrate the failure in version 3.1.1?

thread.title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
thread.author: LavrinenkoRuslan
thread.body:
#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.
